verses.1: Hear this word that I am speaking to you: “Israel’s house will be a place of sorrow for you.”
verses.2: She fell down and could no longer get up. She was left alone on the land of Israel; there was no one to help her.
verses.3: For as the Lord God said, “The city that is built with one thousand people will leave behind a hundred people. And those who leave it after having lived there for a hundred years will leave behind ten people.”
verses.4: For as Jehovah said to the house of Israel, “Ask me and I will give you life.”
verses.5: And do not enter the Temple of God. Do not pass through the Valley of Aven. For the Valley of Aven will be filled with destruction, and the Temple of God will become a ruin.
verses.6: They sought out Jehovah, and they lived, so that the fire might not spread throughout the house of Josaphat. But there was no way to extinguish it in the house of El.
verses.7: Those who turn away from judgment and righteousness in this world, they shall be left behind.
verses.8: He acts like a chemist and a fool. He turns the day into night, and the light into darkness. He makes the sea become land. May the Lord do so!
verses.9: The destroyer will come upon Az and also upon Mibtsar.
verses.10: They hate those who speak truthfully in the street.
verses.11: Therefore, because you are cursed by God, you shall take away from us those who are evil. You shall not dwell in them like vines that bear fruit; you shall not drink their wine.
verses.12: For I know your many sins and your wickedness. You are the ones who cause harm to the righteous, who take away their flocks and homes in the streets.
verses.13: Therefore, the wise man at that time would be covered in dirt, for it was a bad time.
verses.14: Seek only what is good and avoid what is evil, so that you may live. May it be so, O LORD, God of hosts, among you, as you have said.
verses.15: Hate evil and love good. Then they will stand before the judgment seat. Then Jehovah, the God of hosts, will judge them. The rest of the nations will also be judged.
verses.16: Therefore, as the Lord God of hosts says: “In all places, in every corner, they shall say, ‘Holy!’ And from every direction, they shall call out to the gods.
verses.17: And in all the vineyards, as I pass by among you, the LORD says:
verses.18: Oh, how you despise the day of Jehovah! Why is this day of Jehovah so dark and without light for you?
verses.19: When a man stepped into the river, and the dabbit hit him. Then he went inside the house, and he placed his hand on the wall. And the spider crawled onto his hand.
verses.20: It is not dark on the day of the LORD; there is no darkness, nor light, nor gloom.
verses.21: I love your festivals, and I will not rest during your celebrations.
verses.22: For if you bring me gifts and offerings, I will not accept them. Nor will I take your sacrifices or offerings.
verses.23: I cannot hear the songs and hymns of your prophets from above.
verses.24: And it will reveal justice and righteousness like a flowing stream.
verses.25: The offerings and sacrifices were brought to me at the shore, for forty years, during the time when Israel was in exile.
verses.26: And you have set up your own idols as gods, and you have made images of yourselves as your gods. These are the things that you have created for yourselves.
verses.27: And I have brought you out from the hell of darkness into light. Say, “The LORD, God of hosts, may be praised!”
